title: A Haiku remediation agent asks the operator through coord about the leftovers tidy cannot decide, and each answer is claimed before tidy removes it
goal: tidy gives a recorded leftover it cannot decide the verdict ask, and the operator's answer is recorded through coord; kbask.py cleanup makes no model call when tidy decides every candidate and otherwise runs one capped headless Haiku session that writes no file and posts one coord ask per ambiguous candidate; tidy --apply removes an answered candidate only after claiming it through coord, so two sessions never act on the same candidate
